tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search CryptoExchangeIn guides and comparisons by query, country slug (e.g. "india", "us", "uk", "canada", "australia", "nigeria", "eu", "uae", "china"), or topic ("fees", "availability", "wallets", "beginners", "cash_out", "no_kyc").

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Get full verified details for a path (e.g. "/india/is-binance-legal-in-india", "/compare/lowest-fee-crypto-exchange", "/wallets/best-crypto-wallet-for-beginners"): official claim vs. verified reality, pre-trade steps, hidden fees, recommended providers and FAQs.

tools.name: get_country
tools.description: Get the full regulatory status, tax rules, local bank rails, exchange compatibility matrix and top recommended exchanges for a country slug (e.g. "india", "us", "uk", "canada", "australia", "nigeria", "eu", "uae", "china").

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List tested centralized crypto exchanges, hardware cold wallets, software Web3 wallets, and DEX/charting terminals with spot/futures fees, referral codes, and regional coverage.

tools.name: calculate_trade_cost
tools.description: Calculate and rank the true all-in USD cost across crypto exchanges for a given trade amount ($10 to $1,000,000), order mode ("spot_maker", "spot_taker", "instant_buy", "futures_taker"), and optional country slug.

tools.name: report_outdated_info
tools.description: Submit a field report if an exchange fee tier, country KYC rule, bank rail or withdrawal limit has changed.
